Misconfigurations.Title: S3 Access block should block public ACL
Misconfigurations.Description: S3 buckets should block public ACLs on buckets and any objects they contain. By blocking, PUTs with fail if the object has any public ACL a.
Misconfigurations.Message: No public access block so not blocking public acls
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enable blocking any PUT calls with a public ACL specified

Misconfigurations.Title: S3 Access block should block public policy
Misconfigurations.Description: S3 bucket policy should have block public policy to prevent users from putting a policy that enable public access.
Misconfigurations.Message: No public access block so not blocking public policies
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Prevent policies that allow public access being PUT

Misconfigurations.Title: S3 Bucket Logging
Misconfigurations.Description: Ensures S3 bucket logging is enabled for S3 buckets
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add a logging block to the resource to enable access logging

Misconfigurations.Title: S3 Data should be versioned
Misconfigurations.Description:
Versioning in Amazon S3 is a means of keeping multiple variants of an object in the same bucket.

You can use the S3 Versioning feature to preserve, retrieve, and restore every version of every object stored in your buckets.

With versioning you can recover more easily from both unintended user actions and application failures.

When you enable versioning, also keep in mind the potential costs of storing noncurrent versions of objects. To help manage those costs, consider setting up an S3 Lifecycle configuration.
Misconfigurations.Message: Bucket does not have versioning enabled
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enable versioning to protect against accidental/malicious removal or modification

Misconfigurations.Title: S3 Access Block should Ignore Public ACL
Misconfigurations.Description: S3 buckets should ignore public ACLs on buckets and any objects they contain. By ignoring rather than blocking, PUT calls with public ACLs will still be applied but the ACL will be ignored.
Misconfigurations.Message: No public access block so not blocking public acls
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enable ignoring the application of public ACLs in PUT calls

Misconfigurations.Title: S3 Access block should restrict public bucket to limit access
Misconfigurations.Description: S3 buckets should restrict public policies for the bucket. By enabling, the restrict_public_buckets, only the bucket owner and AWS Services can access if it has a public policy.
Misconfigurations.Message: No public access block so not restricting public buckets
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Limit the access to public buckets to only the owner or AWS Services (eg; CloudFront)

Misconfigurations.Title: S3 buckets should each define an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block
Misconfigurations.Description: The "block public access" settings in S3 override individual policies that apply to a given bucket, meaning that all public access can be controlled in one central types for that bucket. It is therefore good practice to define these settings for each bucket in order to clearly define the public access that can be allowed for it.
Misconfigurations.Message: Bucket does not have a corresponding public access block.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Define a aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block for the given bucket to control public access policies

Misconfigurations.Title: S3 encryption should use Customer Managed Keys
Misconfigurations.Description:
Encryption using AWS keys provides protection for your S3 buckets. To gain greater control over encryption, such as key rotation, access policies, and auditability, use customer managed keys (CMKs) with SSE-KMS.
Note that SSE-KMS is not supported for S3 server access logging destination buckets; in such cases, use SSE-S3 instead.
Misconfigurations.Message: Bucket does not encrypt data with a customer managed key.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use SSE-KMS with a customer managed key (CMK)

Misconfigurations.Title: Config configuration aggregator should be using all regions for source
Misconfigurations.Description:
Sources that aren't covered by the aggregator are not include in the configuration. The configuration aggregator should be configured with all_regions for the source.
This will help limit the risk of any unmonitored configuration in regions that are thought to be unused.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set the aggregator to cover all regions

Misconfigurations.Title: IAM Password policy should prevent password reuse.
Misconfigurations.Description:
IAM account password policies should prevent the reuse of passwords.

The account password policy should be set to prevent using any of the last five used passwords.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Prevent password reuse in the policy

Misconfigurations.Title: IAM Password policy should have requirement for at least one lowercase character.
Misconfigurations.Description: IAM account password policies should ensure that passwords content including at least one lowercase character.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enforce longer, more complex passwords in the policy

Misconfigurations.Title: IAM Password policy should have requirement for at least one number in the password.
Misconfigurations.Description: IAM account password policies should ensure that passwords content including at least one number.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enforce longer, more complex passwords in the policy

Misconfigurations.Title: IAM Password policy should have requirement for at least one symbol in the password.
Misconfigurations.Description: IAM account password policies should ensure that passwords content including a symbol.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enforce longer, more complex passwords in the policy

Misconfigurations.Title: IAM Password policy should have requirement for at least one uppercase character.
Misconfigurations.Description:
,

IAM account password policies should ensure that passwords content including at least one uppercase character.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enforce longer, more complex passwords in the policy

Misconfigurations.Title: IAM Password policy should have expiry less than or equal to 90 days.
Misconfigurations.Description:
IAM account password policies should have a maximum age specified.

The account password policy should be set to expire passwords after 90 days or less.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Limit the password duration with an expiry in the policy

Misconfigurations.Title: IAM Password policy should have minimum password length of 14 or more characters.
Misconfigurations.Description:
IAM account password policies should ensure that passwords have a minimum length.

The account password policy should be set to enforce minimum password length of at least 14 characters.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enforce longer, more complex passwords in the policy

Misconfigurations.Title: RDS Cluster and RDS instance should have backup retention longer than default 1 day
Misconfigurations.Description: RDS backup retention for clusters defaults to 1 day, this may not be enough to identify and respond to an issue. Backup retention periods should be set to a period that is a balance on cost and limiting risk.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Explicitly set the retention period to greater than the default

Misconfigurations.Title: Performance Insights encryption should use Customer Managed Keys
Misconfigurations.Description:
Amazon RDS uses the AWS managed key for your new DB instance. For complete control over KMS keys, including establishing and maintaining their key policies, IAM policies, and grants, enabling and disabling them, and rotating their cryptographic material, use a customer managed keys.
The encryption key specified in `performance_insights_kms_key_id` references a KMS ARN
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use Customer Managed Keys to encrypt Performance Insights data

Misconfigurations.Title: There is no encryption specified or encryption is disabled on the RDS Cluster.
Misconfigurations.Description:
Encryption should be enabled for an RDS Aurora cluster.
When enabling encryption by setting the kms_key_id, the storage_encrypted must also be set to true.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enable encryption for RDS clusters

Misconfigurations.Title: RDS encryption has not been enabled at a DB Instance level.
Misconfigurations.Description:
Encryption should be enabled for an RDS Database instances.
When enabling encryption by setting the kms_key_id.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enable encryption for RDS instances

Misconfigurations.Title: S3 Buckets not publicly accessible through ACL.
Misconfigurations.Description: Buckets should not have ACLs that allow public access
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Don't use canned ACLs or switch to private acl

Misconfigurations.Title: IAM groups should have MFA enforcement activated.
Misconfigurations.Description: IAM groups should be protected with multi factor authentication to add safe guards to password compromise.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use terraform-module/enforce-mfa/aws to ensure that MFA is enforced

Misconfigurations.Title: Enable Performance Insights to detect potential problems
Misconfigurations.Description:
Enabling Performance insights allows for greater depth in monitoring data.
For example, information about active sessions could help diagose a compromise or assist in the investigation
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enable performance insights

Misconfigurations.Title: The "root" account has unrestricted access to all resources in the AWS account. It is highly recommended that the use of this account be avoided.
Misconfigurations.Description: The root user has unrestricted access to all services and resources in an AWS account. We highly recommend that you avoid using the root user for daily tasks. Minimizing the use of the root user and adopting the principle of least privilege for access management reduce the risk of accidental changes and unintended disclosure of highly privileged credentials.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use lower privileged accounts instead, so only required privileges are available.

Misconfigurations.Title: The root user has complete access to all services and resources in an AWS account. AWS Access Keys provide programmatic access to a given account.
Misconfigurations.Description: CIS recommends that all access keys be associated with the root user be removed. Removing access keys associated with the root user limits vectors that the account can be compromised by. Removing the root user access keys also encourages the creation and use of role-based accounts that are least privileged.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use lower privileged accounts instead, so only required privileges are available.

Misconfigurations.Title: IAM policies should not be granted directly to users.
Misconfigurations.Description: CIS recommends that you apply IAM policies directly to groups and roles but not users. Assigning privileges at the group or role level reduces the complexity of access management as the number of users grow. Reducing access management complexity might in turn reduce opportunity for a principal to inadvertently receive or retain excessive privileges.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Grant policies at the group level instead.

Misconfigurations.Title: RDS IAM Database Authentication Disabled
Misconfigurations.Description: Ensure IAM Database Authentication is enabled for RDS database instances to manage database access
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Modify the PostgreSQL and MySQL type RDS instances to enable IAM database authentication.

Misconfigurations.Title: RDS Deletion Protection Disabled
Misconfigurations.Description: Ensure deletion protection is enabled for RDS database instances.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Modify the RDS instances to enable deletion protection.

Misconfigurations.Title: RDS Publicly Accessible
Misconfigurations.Description: Ensures RDS instances and RDS Cluster instances are not launched into the public cloud.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Remove the public endpoint from the RDS instance.

Misconfigurations.Title: S3 DNS Compliant Bucket Names
Misconfigurations.Description: Ensures that S3 buckets have DNS complaint bucket names.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Recreate S3 bucket to use - instead of . in S3 bucket names

Misconfigurations.Title: IAM Pass Role Filtering
Misconfigurations.Description: Ensures any IAM pass role attached to roles are flagged and warned.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Resolve permission escalations by denying pass role'

Misconfigurations.Title: RDS Cluster Deletion Protection Disabled
Misconfigurations.Description: Ensure deletion protection is enabled for RDS clusters.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Modify the RDS clusters to enable deletion protection.

Misconfigurations.Title: Disallow unrestricted S3 IAM Policies
Misconfigurations.Description: Ensure that the creation of the unrestricted S3 IAM policies is disallowed.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Create more restrictive S3 policies

Misconfigurations.Title: Reduce unnecessary unauthorized access or information disclosure of S3 buckets.
Misconfigurations.Description: Unnecessary access to S3 buckets can lead to unauthorized access or information disclosure.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Allowing Get* along with Put* on all Resources can potentially allow unauthorized access and/or information disclosure from sensitive buckets.

Misconfigurations.Title: Image user should not be 'root'
Misconfigurations.Description: Running containers with 'root' user can lead to a container escape situation. It is a best practice to run containers as non-root users, which can be done by adding a 'USER' statement to the Dockerfile.
Misconfigurations.Message: Last USER command in Dockerfile should not be 'root'
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add 'USER <non root user name>' line to the Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: No HEALTHCHECK defined
Misconfigurations.Description: You should add HEALTHCHECK instruction in your docker container images to perform the health check on running containers.
Misconfigurations.Message: Add HEALTHCHECK instruction in your Dockerfile
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add HEALTHCHECK instruction in Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: ':latest' tag used
Misconfigurations.Description: When using a 'FROM' statement you should use a specific tag to avoid uncontrolled behavior when the image is updated.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add a tag to the image in the 'FROM' statement

Misconfigurations.Title: Port 22 exposed
Misconfigurations.Description: Exposing port 22 might allow users to SSH into the container.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Remove 'EXPOSE 22' statement from the Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: ADD instead of COPY
Misconfigurations.Description: You should use COPY instead of ADD unless you want to extract a tar file. Note that an ADD command will extract a tar file, which adds the risk of Zip-based vulnerabilities. Accordingly, it is advised to use a COPY command, which does not extract tar files.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use COPY instead of ADD

Misconfigurations.Title: COPY '--from' referring to the current image
Misconfigurations.Description: COPY '--from' should not mention the current FROM alias, since it is impossible to copy from itself.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Change the '--from' so that it will not refer to itself

Misconfigurations.Title: Multiple ENTRYPOINT instructions listed
Misconfigurations.Description: There can only be one ENTRYPOINT instruction in a Dockerfile. Only the last ENTRYPOINT instruction in the Dockerfile will have an effect.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Remove unnecessary ENTRYPOINT instruction.

Misconfigurations.Title: Exposed port out of range
Misconfigurations.Description: UNIX ports outside the range 0-65535 are exposed.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use port number within range

Misconfigurations.Title: WORKDIR path not absolute
Misconfigurations.Description: For clarity and reliability, you should always use absolute paths for your WORKDIR.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use absolute paths for your WORKDIR

Misconfigurations.Title: RUN using 'sudo'
Misconfigurations.Description: Avoid using 'RUN' with 'sudo' commands, as it can lead to unpredictable behavior.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Don't use sudo

Misconfigurations.Title: COPY with more than two arguments not ending with slash
Misconfigurations.Description: When a COPY command has more than two arguments, the last one should end with a slash.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add slash to last COPY argument

Misconfigurations.Title: Duplicate aliases defined in different FROMs
Misconfigurations.Description: Different FROMs can't have the same alias defined.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Change aliases to make them different

Misconfigurations.Title: 'RUN cd ...' to change directory
Misconfigurations.Description: Use WORKDIR instead of proliferating instructions like 'RUN cd … && do-something', which are hard to read, troubleshoot, and maintain.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use WORKDIR to change directory

Misconfigurations.Title: RUN using 'wget' and 'curl'
Misconfigurations.Description: Avoid using both 'wget' and 'curl' since these tools have the same effect.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Pick one util, either 'wget' or 'curl'

Misconfigurations.Title: 'yum clean all' missing
Misconfigurations.Description: You should use 'yum clean all' after using a 'yum install' command to clean package cached data and reduce image size.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add 'yum clean all' to Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: Multiple CMD instructions listed
Misconfigurations.Description: There can only be one CMD instruction in a Dockerfile. If you list more than one CMD then only the last CMD will take effect.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Dockerfile should only have one CMD instruction. Remove all the other CMD instructions

Misconfigurations.Title: 'RUN <package-manager> update' instruction alone
Misconfigurations.Description: The instruction 'RUN <package-manager> update' should always be followed by '<package-manager> install' in the same RUN statement.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Combine '<package-manager> update' and '<package-manager> install' instructions to single one

Misconfigurations.Title: 'dnf clean all' missing
Misconfigurations.Description: Cached package data should be cleaned after installation to reduce image size.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add 'dnf clean all' to Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: 'zypper clean' missing
Misconfigurations.Description: The layer and image size should be reduced by deleting unneeded caches after running zypper.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add 'zypper clean' to Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: 'apt-get' missing '-y' to avoid manual input
Misconfigurations.Description: 'apt-get' calls should use the flag '-y' to avoid manual user input.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add '-y' flag to 'apt-get'

Misconfigurations.Title: Deprecated MAINTAINER used
Misconfigurations.Description: MAINTAINER has been deprecated since Docker 1.13.0.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use LABEL instead of MAINTAINER

Misconfigurations.Title: Multiple HEALTHCHECK defined
Misconfigurations.Description: Providing more than one HEALTHCHECK instruction per stage is confusing and error-prone.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: One HEALTHCHECK instruction must remain in Dockerfile. Remove all other instructions.

Misconfigurations.Title: 'apk add' is missing '--no-cache'
Misconfigurations.Description: You should use 'apk add' with '--no-cache' to clean package cached data and reduce image size.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add '--no-cache' to 'apk add' in Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: 'microdnf clean all' missing
Misconfigurations.Description: Cached package data should be cleaned after installation to reduce image size.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add 'microdnf clean all' to Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: 'apt-get' missing '--no-install-recommends'
Misconfigurations.Description: 'apt-get' install should use '--no-install-recommends' to minimize image size.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add '--no-install-recommends' flag to 'apt-get'

Misconfigurations.Title: WORKDIR should not be mounted on system dirs
Misconfigurations.Description: WORKDIR should not be mounted on system directories to avoid container breakouts
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Avoid using system directories to mount WORKDIR

Misconfigurations.Title: Secrets passed via `build-args` or envs or copied secret files
Misconfigurations.Description: Passing secrets via `build-args` or envs or copying secret files can leak them out
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use secret mount if secrets are needed during image build. Use volume mount if secret files are needed during container runtime.

Misconfigurations.Title: Can elevate its own privileges
Misconfigurations.Description: A program inside the container can elevate its own privileges and run as root, which might give the program control over the container and node.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of Deployment 'insecure-demo-demo' should set 'securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation' to false
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'set containers[].securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation' to 'false'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Default capabilities: some containers do not drop all
Misconfigurations.Description: The container should drop all default capabilities and add only those that are needed for its execution.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of Deployment 'insecure-demo-demo' should add 'ALL' to 'securityContext.capabilities.drop'
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add 'ALL' to containers[].securityContext.capabilities.drop.

Misconfigurations.Title: Default capabilities: some containers do not drop any
Misconfigurations.Description: Security best practices require containers to run with minimal required capabilities.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of 'deployment' 'insecure-demo-demo' in 'default' namespace should set securityContext.capabilities.drop
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Specify at least one unneeded capability in 'containers[].securityContext.capabilities.drop'

Misconfigurations.Title: CPU not limited
Misconfigurations.Description: Enforcing CPU limits prevents DoS via resource exhaustion.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set a limit value under 'containers[].resources.limits.cpu'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs as root user
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the running image to run as a non-root user to ensure least privileges.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of Deployment 'insecure-demo-demo' should set 'securityContext.runAsNonRoot' to true
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'containers[].securityContext.runAsNonRoot' to true.

Misconfigurations.Title: Root file system is not read-only
Misconfigurations.Description: An immutable root file system prevents applications from writing to their local disk. This can limit intrusions, as attackers will not be able to tamper with the file system or write foreign executables to disk.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of Deployment 'insecure-demo-demo' should set 'securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem' to true
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Change 'containers[].securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem' to 'true'.

Misconfigurations.Title: CPU requests not specified
Misconfigurations.Description: When containers have resource requests specified, the scheduler can make better decisions about which nodes to place pods on, and how to deal with resource contention.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'containers[].resources.requests.cpu'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Memory requests not specified
Misconfigurations.Description: When containers have memory requests specified, the scheduler can make better decisions about which nodes to place pods on, and how to deal with resource contention.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'containers[].resources.requests.memory'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Privileged
Misconfigurations.Description: Privileged containers share namespaces with the host system and do not offer any security. They should be used exclusively for system containers that require high privileges.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of Deployment 'insecure-demo-demo' should set 'securityContext.privileged' to false
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Change 'containers[].securityContext.privileged' to 'false'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Memory not limited
Misconfigurations.Description: Enforcing memory limits prevents DoS via resource exhaustion.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set a limit value under 'containers[].resources.limits.memory'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs with UID <= 10000
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the container to run with user ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'containers[].securityContext.runAsUser' to an integer > 10000.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs with GID <= 10000
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the container to run with group ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'containers[].securityContext.runAsGroup' to an integer > 10000.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runtime/Default Seccomp profile not set
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard 'Seccomp', the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile must be required, or allow specific additional profiles.
Misconfigurations.Message: Either Pod or Container should set 'securityContext.seccompProfile.type' to 'RuntimeDefault'
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type', 'spec.containers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile' and 'spec.initContainers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile' to 'RuntimeDefault' or undefined.

Misconfigurations.Title: Seccomp policies disabled
Misconfigurations.Description: A program inside the container can bypass Seccomp protection policies.
Misconfigurations.Message: container "demo" of deployment "insecure-demo-demo" in "default" namespace should specify a seccomp profile
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Specify seccomp either by annotation or by seccomp profile type having allowed values as per pod security standards

Misconfigurations.Title: Container capabilities must only include NET_BIND_SERVICE
Misconfigurations.Description: Containers must drop ALL capabilities, and are only permitted to add back the NET_BIND_SERVICE capability.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.drop' to 'ALL' and only add 'NET_BIND_SERVICE' to 'spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Workloads in the default namespace
Misconfigurations.Description: Checks whether a workload is running in the default namespace.
Misconfigurations.Message: deployment insecure-demo-demo in default namespace should set metadata.namespace to a non-default namespace
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'metadata.namespace' to a non-default namespace.

Misconfigurations.Title: Default security context configured
Misconfigurations.Description: Security context controls the allocation of security parameters for the pod/container/volume, ensuring the appropriate level of protection. Relying on default security context may expose vulnerabilities to potential attacks that rely on privileged access.
Misconfigurations.Message: deployment insecure-demo-demo in default namespace is using the default security context, which allows root privileges
Misconfigurations.Resolution: To enhance security, it is strongly recommended not to rely on the default security context. Instead, it is advisable to explicitly define the required security parameters (such as runAsNonRoot, capabilities, readOnlyRootFilesystem, etc.) within the security context.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --anonymous-auth argument is set to false
Misconfigurations.Description: Disable anonymous requests to the API server.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set '--anonymous-auth' to 'false'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --token-auth-file parameter is not set
Misconfigurations.Description: Do not use token based authentication.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Follow the documentation and configure alternate mechanisms for authentication. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the master node and remove the --token-auth-file=<filename> parameter.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --DenyServiceExternalIPs is not set
Misconfigurations.Description: This admission controller rejects all net-new usage of the Service field externalIPs.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf on the control plane node and remove the `DenyServiceExternalIPs` from enabled admission plugins.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --kubelet-https argument is set to true
Misconfigurations.Description: Use https for kubelet connections.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and remove the --kubelet-https parameter.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --kubelet-client-certificate and --kubelet-client-key arguments are set as appropriate
Misconfigurations.Description: Enable certificate based kubelet authentication.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and set up the TLS connection between the apiserver and kubelets.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --kubelet-certificate-authority argument is set as appropriate
Misconfigurations.Description: Verify kubelet's certificate before establishing connection.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and setup the TLS connection between the apiserver and kubelets.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument is not set to AlwaysAllow
Misconfigurations.Description: Do not always authorize all requests.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --authorization-mode parameter to values other than AlwaysAllow.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument includes Node
Misconfigurations.Description: Restrict kubelet nodes to reading only objects associated with them.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --authorization-mode parameter to a value that includes Node.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument includes RBAC
Misconfigurations.Description: Turn on Role Based Access Control.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --authorization-mode parameter to a value that includes RBAC.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the admission control plugin EventRateLimit is set
Misconfigurations.Description: Limit the rate at which the API server accepts requests.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and set the desired limits in a configuration file. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml and set the below parameters.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the admission control plugin AlwaysAdmit is not set
Misconfigurations.Description: Do not allow all requests.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and either remove the --enable-admission- plugins parameter, or set it to a value that does not include AlwaysAdmit.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the admission control plugin AlwaysPullImages is set
Misconfigurations.Description: Always pull images.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --enable-admission-plugins parameter to include AlwaysPullImages.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the admission control plugin ServiceAccount is set
Misconfigurations.Description: Automate service accounts management.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Follow the documentation and create ServiceAccount objects as per your environment. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the master node and ensure that the --disable-admission-plugins parameter is set to a value that does not include ServiceAccount.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the admission control plugin NamespaceLifecycle is set
Misconfigurations.Description: Reject creating objects in a namespace that is undergoing termination.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --disable-admission-plugins parameter to ensure it does not include NamespaceLifecycle.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the admission control plugin NodeRestriction is set
Misconfigurations.Description: Limit the Node and Pod objects that a kubelet could modify.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and configure NodeRestriction plug-in on kubelets. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the master node and set the --enable-admission-plugins parameter to a value that includes NodeRestriction.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --secure-port argument is not set to 0

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --etcd-cafile argument is set as appropriate

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --encryption-provider-config argument is set as appropriate

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --terminated-pod-gc-threshold argument is set as appropriate

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --bind-address argument is set to 127.0.0.1

Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml on the Control Plane node and ensure the correct value for the --bind-address parameter

Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the Scheduler pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-scheduler.yaml on the Control Plane node and ensure the correct value for the --bind-address parameter.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --cert-file and --key-file arguments are set as appropriate
Misconfigurations.Description: Configure TLS encryption for the etcd service.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Follow the etcd service documentation and configure TLS encryption. Then, edit the etcd pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml on the master node and set the below parameters.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --client-cert-auth argument is set to true
Misconfigurations.Description: Enable client authentication on etcd service.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the etcd pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml on the master node and set the below parameter.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --auto-tls argument is not set to true

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure ingress-nginx annotations are secure
Misconfigurations.Description: Check for insecure annotations in ingress-nginx configurations.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Ensure that ingress-nginx annotations do not contain suspicious characters.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runtime/Default AppArmor profile not set
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard 'AppArmor', the AppArmor key must be set to the runtime/default profile or to be undefined.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: set the 'runtime/default' value from 'container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io'.

Misconfigurations.Title: SYS_ADMIN capability added
Misconfigurations.Description: SYS_ADMIN gives the processes running inside the container privileges that are equivalent to root.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Remove the SYS_ADMIN capability from 'containers[].securityContext.capabilities.add'.

Misconfigurations.Title: hostPath volume mounted with docker.sock
Misconfigurations.Description: Mounting docker.sock from the host can give the container full root access to the host.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not specify /var/run/docker.socket in 'spec.template.volumes.hostPath.path'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Manages /etc/hosts
Misconfigurations.Description: Managing /etc/hosts aliases can prevent the container engine from modifying the file after a pod’s containers have already been started.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not set 'spec.template.spec.hostAliases'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Access to host IPC namespace
Misconfigurations.Description: Sharing the host’s IPC namespace allows container processes to communicate with processes on the host.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not set 'spec.template.spec.hostIPC' to true.

Misconfigurations.Title: Access to host network
Misconfigurations.Description: Sharing the host’s network namespace permits processes in the pod to communicate with processes bound to the host’s loopback adapter.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not set 'spec.template.spec.hostNetwork' to true.

Misconfigurations.Title: Access to host PID
Misconfigurations.Description: Sharing the host’s PID namespace allows visibility on host processes, potentially leaking information such as environment variables and configuration.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not set 'spec.template.spec.hostPID' to true.

Misconfigurations.Title: Image tag ":latest" used
Misconfigurations.Description: It is best to avoid using the ':latest' image tag when deploying containers in production. Doing so makes it hard to track which version of the image is running, and hard to roll back the version.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use a specific container image tag that is not 'latest'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Specific capabilities added
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard 'Capabilities', capabilities beyond the default set must not be added.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not set spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add and spec.initContainers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add.

Misconfigurations.Title: hostPath volumes mounted
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard 'HostPath Volumes', HostPath volumes must be forbidden.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not set 'spec.volumes[*].hostPath'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Access to host ports
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard 'Host Ports', hostPorts should be disallowed, or at minimum restricted to a known list.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not set spec.containers[*].ports[*].hostPort and spec.initContainers[*].ports[*].hostPort.

Misconfigurations.Title: SELinux custom options set
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard 'SElinux', setting custom SELinux options should be disallowed.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not set 'spec.securityContext.seLinuxOptions', spec.containers[*].securityContext.seLinuxOptions and spec.initContainers[*].securityContext.seLinuxOptions.

Misconfigurations.Title: Unsafe sysctl options set
Misconfigurations.Description: Sysctls can disable security mechanisms or affect all containers on a host, and should be disallowed except for an allowed 'safe' subset. A sysctl is considered safe if it is namespaced in the container or the Pod, and it is isolated from other Pods or processes on the same Node.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not set 'spec.securityContext.sysctls' or set to values in an allowed subset

Misconfigurations.Title: Non-default /proc masks set
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard '/proc Mount Type', the default /proc masks are set up to reduce attack surface, and should be required.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not set spec.containers[*].securityContext.procMount and spec.initContainers[*].securityContext.procMount.

Misconfigurations.Title: Non-core volume types used.
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard 'Volume types', non-core volume types must not be used.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not Set 'spec.volumes[*]' to any of the disallowed volume types.

Misconfigurations.Title: Protecting Pod service account tokens
Misconfigurations.Description: ensure that Pod specifications disable the secret token being mounted by setting automountServiceAccountToken: false
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Disable the mounting of service account secret token by setting automountServiceAccountToken to false

Misconfigurations.Title: User resources should not be placed in kube-system namespace
Misconfigurations.Description: ensure that user resources are not placed in kube-system namespace
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Deploy the user resources into a designated namespace which is not kube-system.

Misconfigurations.Title: Selector usage in network policies
Misconfigurations.Description: ensure that network policies selectors are applied to pods or namespaces to restricted ingress and egress traffic within the pod network
Misconfigurations.Resolution: create network policies and ensure that pods are selected using the podSelector and/or the namespaceSelector options

Misconfigurations.Title: Do not allow impersonation of privileged groups
Misconfigurations.Description: Check whether role permits impersonating privileged groups
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Create a role which does not permit to impersonate privileged groups if not needed

Misconfigurations.Title: No wildcard verb and resource roles
Misconfigurations.Description: Check whether role permits wildcard verb on wildcard resource
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Create a role which does not permit wildcard verb on wildcard resource

Misconfigurations.Title: No wildcard verb roles
Misconfigurations.Description: Check whether role permits wildcard verb on specific resources
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Create a role which does not permit wildcard verb on specific resources

Misconfigurations.Title: Do not allow privilege escalation from node proxy
Misconfigurations.Description: Check whether role permits privilege escalation from node proxy
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Create a role which does not permit privilege escalation from node proxy

Misconfigurations.Title: Do not allow role binding creation and association with privileged role/clusterrole
Misconfigurations.Description: Check whether role permits creating role bindings and associating to privileged role/clusterrole
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Create a role which does not permit creation of role bindings and associating with privileged cluster role

Misconfigurations.Title: Do not allow role to create ClusterRoleBindings and association with privileged role
Misconfigurations.Description: Check whether role permits creating role ClusterRoleBindings and association with privileged cluster role
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Create a role which does not permit to create role clusterrolebindings and associate to privileged cluster role

Misconfigurations.Title: Do not allow attaching to shell on pods
Misconfigurations.Description: Check whether role permits attaching to shell on pods
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Create a role which does not permit attaching to shell on pods

Misconfigurations.Title: Do not allow users in a rolebinding to add other users to their rolebindings
Misconfigurations.Description: Check whether role permits allowing users in a rolebinding to add other users to their rolebindings
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Create a role which does not permit allowing users in a rolebinding to add other users to their rolebindings if not needed

Misconfigurations.Title: Tiller Is Deployed
Misconfigurations.Description: Check if Helm Tiller component is deployed.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Migrate to Helm v3 which no longer has Tiller component

Misconfigurations.Title: Access to host process
Misconfigurations.Description: Windows pods offer the ability to run HostProcess containers which enable privileged access to the Windows node.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not enable 'hostProcess' on any securityContext

Misconfigurations.Title: Containers must not set runAsUser to 0
Misconfigurations.Description: Containers should be forbidden from running with a root UID.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'securityContext.runAsUser' to a non-zero integer or leave undefined.

Misconfigurations.Title: The deprecated 'apiVersion' and 'kind' should not be used
Misconfigurations.Description: The specified 'apiVersion' and 'kind' are deprecated and are planned to be removed
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Migrate resource to new API

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs with a root primary or supplementary GID
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard 'Non-root groups', containers should be forbidden from running with a root primary or supplementary GID.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'containers[].securityContext.runAsGroup' to a non-zero integer or leave undefined.

Misconfigurations.Title: Prevent binding to privileged ports
Misconfigurations.Description: The ports which are lower than 1024 receive and transmit various sensitive and privileged data. Allowing containers to use them can bring serious implications.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not map the container ports to privileged host ports when starting a container.

Misconfigurations.Title: NET_RAW capability added
Misconfigurations.Description: The NET_RAW capability grants attackers the ability to eavesdrop on network traffic or generate IP traffic with falsified source addresses, posing serious security risks.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: To mitigate potential security risks, it is strongly recommended to remove the NET_RAW capability from 'containers[].securityContext.capabilities.add'. It is advisable to follow the practice of dropping all capabilities and only adding the necessary ones.

Misconfigurations.Title: SYS_MODULE capability added
Misconfigurations.Description: The SYS_MODULE capability grants attackers the ability to install and remove kernel modules, posing serious security risks.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: To mitigate potential security risks, it is strongly recommended to remove the SYS_MODULE capability from 'containers[].securityContext.capabilities.add'. It is advisable to follow the practice of dropping all capabilities and only adding the necessary ones.

Misconfigurations.Title: Kubernetes resource with disallowed volumes mounted
Misconfigurations.Description: HostPath present many security risks and as a security practice it is better to avoid critical host paths mounts.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not Set 'spec.volumes[*].hostPath.path' to any of the disallowed volumes.

Misconfigurations.Title: Gatekeeper repo reference is ambiguously open-ended
Misconfigurations.Description: A Gatekeeper policy that references image repositories for prefix-matching is using open-ended and ambiguous pattern, and can potentially match unintended repositories.

Misconfigurations.Title: Restrict container images to trusted registries
Misconfigurations.Description: Ensure that all containers use images only from trusted registry domains.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use images from trusted registries.

Misconfigurations.Title: Can elevate its own privileges
Misconfigurations.Description: A program inside the container can elevate its own privileges and run as root, which might give the program control over the container and node.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of Deployment 'insecure-demo' should set 'securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation' to false
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'set containers[].securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation' to 'false'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Default capabilities: some containers do not drop all
Misconfigurations.Description: The container should drop all default capabilities and add only those that are needed for its execution.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of Deployment 'insecure-demo' should add 'ALL' to 'securityContext.capabilities.drop'
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add 'ALL' to containers[].securityContext.capabilities.drop.

Misconfigurations.Title: Default capabilities: some containers do not drop any
Misconfigurations.Description: Security best practices require containers to run with minimal required capabilities.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of 'deployment' 'insecure-demo' in 'default' namespace should set securityContext.capabilities.drop
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Specify at least one unneeded capability in 'containers[].securityContext.capabilities.drop'

Misconfigurations.Title: CPU not limited
Misconfigurations.Description: Enforcing CPU limits prevents DoS via resource exhaustion.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set a limit value under 'containers[].resources.limits.cpu'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs as root user
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the running image to run as a non-root user to ensure least privileges.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of Deployment 'insecure-demo' should set 'securityContext.runAsNonRoot' to true
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'containers[].securityContext.runAsNonRoot' to true.

Misconfigurations.Title: Root file system is not read-only
Misconfigurations.Description: An immutable root file system prevents applications from writing to their local disk. This can limit intrusions, as attackers will not be able to tamper with the file system or write foreign executables to disk.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of Deployment 'insecure-demo' should set 'securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem' to true
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Change 'containers[].securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem' to 'true'.

Misconfigurations.Title: CPU requests not specified
Misconfigurations.Description: When containers have resource requests specified, the scheduler can make better decisions about which nodes to place pods on, and how to deal with resource contention.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'containers[].resources.requests.cpu'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Memory requests not specified
Misconfigurations.Description: When containers have memory requests specified, the scheduler can make better decisions about which nodes to place pods on, and how to deal with resource contention.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'containers[].resources.requests.memory'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Privileged
Misconfigurations.Description: Privileged containers share namespaces with the host system and do not offer any security. They should be used exclusively for system containers that require high privileges.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'demo' of Deployment 'insecure-demo' should set 'securityContext.privileged' to false
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Change 'containers[].securityContext.privileged' to 'false'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Memory not limited
Misconfigurations.Description: Enforcing memory limits prevents DoS via resource exhaustion.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set a limit value under 'containers[].resources.limits.memory'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs with UID <= 10000
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the container to run with user ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'containers[].securityContext.runAsUser' to an integer > 10000.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs with GID <= 10000
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the container to run with group ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'containers[].securityContext.runAsGroup' to an integer > 10000.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runtime/Default Seccomp profile not set
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard 'Seccomp', the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile must be required, or allow specific additional profiles.
Misconfigurations.Message: Either Pod or Container should set 'securityContext.seccompProfile.type' to 'RuntimeDefault'
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type', 'spec.containers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile' and 'spec.initContainers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile' to 'RuntimeDefault' or undefined.

Misconfigurations.Title: Seccomp policies disabled
Misconfigurations.Description: A program inside the container can bypass Seccomp protection policies.
Misconfigurations.Message: container "demo" of deployment "insecure-demo" in "default" namespace should specify a seccomp profile
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Specify seccomp either by annotation or by seccomp profile type having allowed values as per pod security standards

Misconfigurations.Title: Container capabilities must only include NET_BIND_SERVICE
Misconfigurations.Description: Containers must drop ALL capabilities, and are only permitted to add back the NET_BIND_SERVICE capability.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.drop' to 'ALL' and only add 'NET_BIND_SERVICE' to 'spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Workloads in the default namespace
Misconfigurations.Description: Checks whether a workload is running in the default namespace.
Misconfigurations.Message: deployment insecure-demo in default namespace should set metadata.namespace to a non-default namespace
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'metadata.namespace' to a non-default namespace.

Misconfigurations.Title: Default security context configured
Misconfigurations.Description: Security context controls the allocation of security parameters for the pod/container/volume, ensuring the appropriate level of protection. Relying on default security context may expose vulnerabilities to potential attacks that rely on privileged access.
Misconfigurations.Message: deployment insecure-demo in default namespace is using the default security context, which allows root privileges
Misconfigurations.Resolution: To enhance security, it is strongly recommended not to rely on the default security context. Instead, it is advisable to explicitly define the required security parameters (such as runAsNonRoot, capabilities, readOnlyRootFilesystem, etc.) within the security context.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --anonymous-auth argument is set to false
Misconfigurations.Description: Disable anonymous requests to the API server.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set '--anonymous-auth' to 'false'.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --token-auth-file parameter is not set
Misconfigurations.Description: Do not use token based authentication.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Follow the documentation and configure alternate mechanisms for authentication. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the master node and remove the --token-auth-file=<filename> parameter.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --DenyServiceExternalIPs is not set
Misconfigurations.Description: This admission controller rejects all net-new usage of the Service field externalIPs.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file $apiserverconf on the control plane node and remove the `DenyServiceExternalIPs` from enabled admission plugins.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --kubelet-https argument is set to true
Misconfigurations.Description: Use https for kubelet connections.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and remove the --kubelet-https parameter.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --kubelet-client-certificate and --kubelet-client-key arguments are set as appropriate
Misconfigurations.Description: Enable certificate based kubelet authentication.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and set up the TLS connection between the apiserver and kubelets.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --kubelet-certificate-authority argument is set as appropriate
Misconfigurations.Description: Verify kubelet's certificate before establishing connection.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and setup the TLS connection between the apiserver and kubelets.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument is not set to AlwaysAllow
Misconfigurations.Description: Do not always authorize all requests.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --authorization-mode parameter to values other than AlwaysAllow.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --authorization-mode argument includes Node
Misconfigurations.Description: Restrict kubelet nodes to reading only objects associated with them.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --authorization-mode parameter to a value that includes Node.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the admission control plugin AlwaysAdmit is not set

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the admission control plugin AlwaysPullImages is set

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the admission control plugin ServiceAccount is set

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the admission control plugin NamespaceLifecycle is set

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the admission control plugin NodeRestriction is set

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --secure-port argument is not set to 0

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --profiling argument is set to false

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --audit-log-path argument is set

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --audit-log-maxbackup argument is set to 10 or as appropriate

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --service-account-lookup argument is set to true

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --etcd-certfile and --etcd-keyfile arguments are set as appropriate

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --tls-cert-file and --tls-private-key-file arguments are set as appropriate
Misconfigurations.Description: Setup TLS connection on the API server.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Follow the Kubernetes documentation and set up the TLS connection on the apiserver. Then, edit the API server pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml on the master node and set the TLS certificate and private key file parameters.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --client-ca-file argument is set as appropriate

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --etcd-cafile argument is set as appropriate

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --encryption-provider-config argument is set as appropriate

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --terminated-pod-gc-threshold argument is set as appropriate

Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the --terminated-pod-gc-threshold to an appropriate threshold.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --profiling argument is set to false
Misconfigurations.Description: Disable profiling, if not needed.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml on the Control Plane node and set the below parameter.

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --use-service-account-credentials argument is set to true

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the --root-ca-file argument is set as appropriate

Misconfigurations.Title: Ensure that the RotateKubeletServerCertificate argument is set to true

Misconfigurations.Resolution: Edit the Controller Manager pod specification file /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-controller-manager.yaml on the Control Plane node and ensure the correct value for the --bind-address parameter
